historySummary.label: 历史 AI 摘要 / History AI summary
historySummary.help: 对统一去重后的历史按消息生成摘要，当前请求保持原文。 / Summarize unified history per message after deduplication; preserve the current request.

historySummary.enabled.label: 启用 AI 摘要 / Enable AI summary
historySummary.enabled.help: 默认开启；关闭或失败时使用明确标记的原文摘录。 / Enabled by default; when disabled or unavailable, use explicitly labeled excerpts.

historySummary.triggerChars.label: 摘要触发字符数 / Summary trigger characters
historySummary.triggerChars.help: 默认沿用历史预算（12000），统一计算群历史、引用链和话题历史。 / Defaults to the history budget (12000), counting group, quote and topic history together.

historySummary.targetChars.label: 摘要正文目标字符数 / Target summary characters
historySummary.targetChars.help: 默认 4000，不含消息来源元数据；必带消息逐条保留。 / Default 4000 excluding source metadata; mandatory messages remain individually represented.

historySummary.timeoutMs.label: 摘要超时（毫秒） / Summary timeout (milliseconds)
historySummary.timeoutMs.help: 默认 8000；超时降级为原文摘录。 / Default 8000; fall back to excerpts on timeout.

historySummary.maxInputChars.label: 摘要读取字符预算 / Summary input character budget
historySummary.maxInputChars.help: 默认 200000，与展示预算分开；超过时不发送给摘要模型。 / Default 200000, separate from display budget; larger input is not sent to the summarizer.

historySummary.model.label: 摘要模型 / Summary model
historySummary.model.help: 可选 provider/model，未填沿用当前 Agent 模型。 / Optional provider/model; defaults to the current agent model.

quoteChain.label: 连续引用消息 / Reply chain
quoteChain.help: 逐级读取被回复消息，独立于群历史开关。 / Follow parent messages independently of group history settings.

quoteChain.maxDepth.label: 引用链最大层数 / Maximum reply depth
quoteChain.maxDepth.help: 默认 20，范围 1–100，含直接引用；1 仅读取直接引用。 / Default 20, range 1–100, including the direct quote; 1 reads only the direct quote.

quoteChain.maxChars.label: 引用摘要阈值 / Reply summary threshold
quoteChain.maxChars.help: 默认 24000，范围 1000–100000；参与默认摘要触发阈值，读取预算另设。 / Default 24000, range 1000–100000; contributes to the default summary threshold; fetching has a separate budget.

mentionHistory.label: @ 与引用历史 / Mention and quote history
mentionHistory.help: 群聊 @ 或引用回复触发时补充上下文，账号可覆盖全局配置。 / Supplement group mentions and quoted replies; accounts can override global settings.

mentionHistory.enabled.label: 启用历史读取 / Enable history
mentionHistory.enabled.help: 默认开启。 / Enabled by default.

mentionHistory.recentLimit.label: 每轮必带消息数 / Mandatory recent messages
mentionHistory.recentLimit.help: 默认 5，范围 1–50；不跨轮去重，优先于字符预算。 / Default 5, range 1–50; bypasses cross-turn deduplication and takes priority over the character budget.

mentionHistory.limit.label: 候选拉取条数 / Candidate fetch limit
mentionHistory.limit.help: 默认 20，范围 1–50；实际至少拉取必带条数。 / Default 20, range 1–50; effective limit is at least the mandatory recent count.

mentionHistory.quoteBefore.label: 引用之前条数 / Messages before quote
mentionHistory.quoteBefore.help: 默认 3，范围 0–20；0 关闭向前读取。 / Default 3, range 0–20; zero disables preceding context.

mentionHistory.quoteAfter.label: 引用之后条数 / Messages after quote
mentionHistory.quoteAfter.help: 默认 3，范围 0–20；0 关闭向后读取，仅包含本次触发之前的消息。 / Default 3, range 0–20; zero disables following context; never reads beyond the trigger time.

mentionHistory.deduplicateOlder.label: 更早消息跨轮去重 / Deduplicate older history
mentionHistory.deduplicateOlder.help: 默认开启；关闭后更早候选仍受关联筛选、权限和字符预算限制。 / Enabled by default; disabling retains relevance, visibility and character-budget filtering.

mentionHistory.maxChars.label: 历史摘要阈值 / History summary threshold
mentionHistory.maxChars.help: 默认 12000，范围 1000–50000；未单独配置摘要触发值时使用。 / Default 12000, range 1000–50000; used when no separate summary trigger is configured.

historyLimit.label: 群聊历史条数上限 / Group history limit

dmHistoryLimit.label: 私聊历史条数上限 / DM history limit

dms.label: 私聊配置 / Direct-message settings
dms.help: 以用户 ID 为键设置覆盖项。 / Configure overrides keyed by user ID.

mediaMaxMb.label: 媒体大小上限（MB） / Media size limit (MB)

httpTimeoutMs.label: HTTP 超时（毫秒） / HTTP timeout (ms)

heartbeatVisibility.label: 心跳显示设置 / Heartbeat display settings

heartbeatVisibility.visibility.label: 心跳可见性 / Heartbeat visibility
heartbeatVisibility.visibility.help: visible：显示；hidden：隐藏。 / visible: show; hidden: hide.

heartbeatVisibility.intervalMs.label: 心跳间隔（毫秒） / Heartbeat interval (ms)

renderMode.label: 消息渲染方式 / Message rendering
renderMode.help: auto：自动；raw：纯文本；card：卡片。 / auto: automatic; raw: plain text; card: card messages.

workspaceSync.label: 工作区同步 / Workspace sync
workspaceSync.help: 进入模型前同步资料仓库并刷新技能索引；失败时阻止新轮执行。 / Sync repositories and refresh the skill index before model execution; failure blocks the new turn.

workspaceSync.project.label: 独立项目仓库 / Independent project repository
workspaceSync.project.help: Agent Repo 模式：分别同步角色仓库和选定的 projects/<项目ID>/ 独立仓库。 / Sync the Agent Repo and the selected projects/<projectId>/ repository separately.

workspaceSync.project.path.label: 项目相对目录 / Project relative directory
workspaceSync.project.path.help: 使用 projects/<项目ID>，兼容旧 project 目录；只同步此选定项目。 / Use projects/<projectId>; legacy project is supported. Only this selected project is synchronized.

workspaceSync.project.expectedUrl.label: 预期项目远端 / Expected project remote
workspaceSync.project.expectedUrl.help: 同步前核对真实远端；不匹配时保留现场。 / Verify the remote before synchronization; mismatches block the turn.

workspaceSync.project.remote.label: 项目远端名 / Project remote name

workspaceSync.project.submodules.*.path.label: 子模块相对路径 / Submodule relative path

workspaceSync.enabled.label: 启用工作区同步 / Enable workspace sync

workspaceSync.preserveLocalMemory.label: 保留本地原生记忆 / Preserve local native memory
workspaceSync.preserveLocalMemory.help: 仅 Agent Repo 双仓模式且不合入上游时启用；未暂存的 MEMORY.md 与日期日记可保留，远端同路径修改仍阻止更新，不自动提交。 / Agent Repo dual-repository mode only, without upstream integration; preserve unstaged native notes, block overlapping remote changes, never auto-commit.

workspaceSync.includeUpstream.label: 同步通用上游 / Include upstream
workspaceSync.includeUpstream.help: 默认开启；主仓库同步 origin/main 并预检合入 upstream/main，不自动推送。 / Enabled by default; integrate origin/main and upstream/main after conflict preflight, without pushing.

workspaceSync.root.label: 资料仓库根目录 / Knowledge repository root

workspaceSync.timeoutMs.label: 同步超时（毫秒） / Sync timeout (ms)

departmentReplyStyles.label: 部门回复风格 / Department reply styles
departmentReplyStyles.help: 按列表顺序匹配部门名称，首条命中生效；空列表关闭，账号配置整体覆盖全局。 / Match department names in list order; first match wins. An empty list disables matching; account rules replace global rules.

departmentReplyStyles.*.departmentKeywor.label: 部门关键词 / Department keywords
departmentReplyStyles.*.departmentKeywor.help: 任一关键词命中任一已取得的部门名称即可；不区分大小写，按字面包含匹配。 / Match any keyword in any resolved department name, using case-insensitive literal substring matching.

departmentReplyStyles.*.style.label: 回复风格提示词 / Reply style prompt
departmentReplyStyles.*.style.help: 命中后注入当前发言者的输入上下文，仅调整表达；本轮要求和本人明确偏好优先。 / Inject into the current sender's input context to guide expression; current requests and explicit personal preferences take precedence.

workingCard.label: 工作卡片 / Working card
workingCard.help: 显示等待和工作动图，完成后原地更新结果；默认关闭。 / Show waiting and working animations, then update the card with the result; disabled by default.

workingCard.enabled.label: 启用工作卡片 / Enable working card

streaming.chunkMode.label: 分段方式 / Chunk mode
streaming.chunkMode.help: length：按长度；newline：按换行。 / length: split by length; newline: split at line breaks.
